scope: Godel native window and workspace controls used by Jarvis voice workflows

evidence_policy.live-verified: Observed against authenticated Godel and asserted from resulting state.
evidence_policy.source-verified: Bound to a Godel-owned callback or state manager with a completion assertion, but not every phrase/target combination has a live observation.
evidence_policy.partial: A verified primitive exists but target resolution or runtime state can still make it fail closed.
evidence_policy.unsupported: No exact native operation and completion assertion are available.

move the Meta earnings matrix to the top right
controls.completion: The exact native panel's rendered width and height are within four pixels of the planned rectangle.
limits: Movement is within the active Godel screen only.
Moving an existing native window to another Godel screen is unsupported.

controls.completion: The exact panel is scaled by 1.2 or 0.8, clamped to the workspace and minimum 280 by 190 pixels, then rendered geometry is verified.
limits: Bigger and smaller are proportional, not absolute pixel dimensions.
Repeated requests become no-ops at workspace or minimum bounds.

voice_examples: make the active window full screen
controls.completion: The native position record gains a previous-geometry value.
limits: This maximizes a Godel panel inside the terminal, not the Arc browser window.

controls.completion: The native previous-geometry marker clears after Godel restores the panel.
limits: If the panel is not maximized, restore is an idempotent no-op.

voice_examples: bring the active chart to the front
controls.completion: The active-screen activeWindowId equals the exact target or the panel exposes Godel's active-window flag.
limits: Live focus passed for Earnings Matrix.
A later Index Map attempt failed closed because Godel's native active window identity was unavailable for that mounted panel.
Covered panels from inactive screens are excluded before resolution.

controls.native_binding: the unique data-cy-close-window React onClick callback
controls.completion: The exact native window root disconnects from the document.
safety: Requires explicit close, dismiss, or remove language.
Bulk requests such as close all windows are rejected by the deterministic parser.
CHAT, NOTE, ACCOUNT, BROK, ORDER, TRADE, MESSAGE, and ALERT command families are rejected.
This action never closes an Arc tab or browser window.
limits: When several same-command panels exist, a named security is the safest target; otherwise Jarvis uses the remembered or active instance.

controls.native_binding: pure layout planner followed by exact native setGeometry actions
controls.completion: Every new panel receives an in-bounds rectangle; insufficient space returns explicit overflow.
limits: The current executor preserves existing panels.
Overflow recommends a new screen but does not silently rearrange unrelated panels.

controls.native_binding: workspace provider layout state plus screen-tab onSelect and onEdit callbacks
controls.completion: The requested exact screen title exists and its screen id is active.
limits: Godel allows at most eight screens.
An empty Voice or Blank screen is reused before creating another.
